time_contract.alarm_delay_policy: elapsed simulation time, never sample count
time_contract.rate_boundary_policy: hold latest physical sample between synchronization points; do not claim sub-sample physical crossing time without supporting RAW

rules: START never closes a feeder breaker implicitly.
Normal STOP removes run enable but does not trip the feeder breaker.
TRIP is not proven by analog process reduction; it requires associated breaker CLOSED feedback = 0.
DERATE changes a process boundary while the associated generator breaker remains CLOSED.
RESET clears a latched state only when reset permissives are satisfied; it does not restart equipment.
BREAKER_CLOSE and START are separate actions.
VALVE_POSITION is enabled only after the target valve has an explicit validated physical binding.
